changeSet.author: VKyrychuk
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE assetType ADD AutoDisplayDescription bit DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL ;
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE assetType DROP COLUMN AutoDisplayDescription;

changeSet.author: VKyrychuk
changeSet.sql: ALTER TRIGGER ArtifactType_AfterInsert ON ArtifactType AFTER INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON insert into AssetType (Name, Description, Class, DisplayFormat, [State], [Hierarchical], [HierarchyMaximumDepth], [Object], [ObjectID], [CreatedOn], [CreatedBy], [UpdatedOn], [UpdatedBy],[CanOwnFusion],[AutoDisplayDescription]) select Name, Description, 1, DisplayFormat, 1, 0, 1, 'ArtifactType', ID, coalesce(UpdatedOn, getutcdate()), UpdatedBy, coalesce(UpdatedOn, getutcdate()), UpdatedBy, CanOwnFusion,AutoDisplayDescription from inserted
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TRIGGER ArtifactType_AfterInsert ON ArtifactType AFTER INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON insert into AssetType (Name, Description, Class, DisplayFormat, [State], [Hierarchical], [HierarchyMaximumDepth], [Object], [ObjectID], [CreatedOn], [CreatedBy], [UpdatedOn], [UpdatedBy],[CanOwnFusion]) select Name, Description, 1, DisplayFormat, 1, 0, 1, 'ArtifactType', ID, coalesce(UpdatedOn, getutcdate()), UpdatedBy, coalesce(UpdatedOn, getutcdate()), UpdatedBy, CanOwnFusion from inserted

changeSet.author: VKyrychuk
changeSet.sql: ALTER TRIGGER ArtifactType_AfterUpdate ON ArtifactType AFTER UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON update T set T.Name = S.Name, T.Description = S.Description, T.CanOwnFusion= S.CanOwnFusion, T.AutoDisplayDescription= S.AutoDisplayDescription, T.DisplayFormat = S.DisplayFormat, T.UpdatedBy = S.UpdatedBy, T.UpdatedOn = S.UpdatedOn from AssetType T inner join inserted S on T.Object = 'ArtifactType' and T.ObjectID = S.ID
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TRIGGER ArtifactType_AfterUpdate ON ArtifactType AFTER UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON update T set T.Name = S.Name, T.Description = S.Description, T.CanOwnFusion= S.CanOwnFusion, T.DisplayFormat = S.DisplayFormat, T.UpdatedBy = S.UpdatedBy, T.UpdatedOn = S.UpdatedOn from AssetType T inner join inserted S on T.Object = 'ArtifactType' and T.ObjectID = S.ID
